answer: Require each agent to stake a refundable bond that is slashed if it vouches for a fake peer, like a terrace built stone by stone: a newcomer must earn vouches slowly from established agents on higher ground, not flood the knoll at once. A Sybil farmer facing an ocean of cheap identities still pays a real bond and waiting time per identity, so creating thousands costs thousands of bonds and months of reputation, while honest agents pay once and keep theirs.
